name: history-rail
title: History Rail
description: A form that removes the anxiety of editing, and shows its own mechanism instead of making you guess it: a labeled "Edit history" rail with a live "Checkpoint 1 of 2" readout, and a real progress ring that fills in place while you pause, so you watch a checkpoint form before it ever commits. Every 900ms pause creates a real, clickable checkpoint, not a hidden undo stack; hover a past dot for a preview before you commit to jumping, jump anywhere any time, no "discard changes?" dialog anywhere, and editing from an old checkpoint gracefully fades away the future dots it replaces instead of just erasing them.
